title: Geothermal Potential of the Pannonian Basin
grammar: Thermal Water Reservoirs, District Heating and Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS)
goal: I can describe geothermal energy in the Pannonian Basin and district heating in Szeged (*hévíz, távfűtés, visszasajtolás*).
